Designing a floating Markdown panel

How can I keep the export controls close to my conversation?

Use a small floating button with a stable anchor. Opening a panel should preserve its position.

  • Export your current conversation as Markdown.
  • Select loaded conversations for a ZIP backup.
  • Keep all processing inside your browser.
const privacy = "local only";
const anchor = { x: 14, y: 300 };

Native actions stay disabled until verified.
